summary.text: Bob Morgan is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 58th District, serving since January 2019, according to the Illinois General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Morgan's legislature biography describes a health care attorney with a B.A. from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and a J.D. from Northern Illinois University.
It says Morgan was formerly a health care attorney for the Illinois Office of the Governor and general counsel for the Illinois Department of Public Health.
